provenance.public_source_provenance_note: Publicly accessible U.S. federal environmental-reporting page retrieved without authentication. EPA attribution and the canonical URL are retained; no licensing inference is made beyond public accessibility.

selection_rule_evidence.first_eligible_passage: First consecutive explanatory body paragraphs in page order whose cumulative length reaches 300 words, spanning the importance, stressor, and national-indicator explanation after headings and navigation are removed.
selection_rule_evidence.source_scope: Opening explanatory prose through the final paragraph explaining national-scale indicator difficulty.
